test_title: PYST 36: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 16 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A person starts from point G and moves 10 km East. He turns left and moves 5 km, turns left again moves 5 km, then turns right and moves 3 km and takes a final left turn and moves 5 km to reach a point F. How much and in which direction does he need to move now to reach point G?
solution:
According to the question;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152d4ff908f034033ed9ff0aff50fa6e349e96307134b638766df1351abe2530.png] 

The person need to go 8km south to reach Point G.

Hence, the correct answer is **option (1).**
